description: Deploy the Lambda capacity poller to AWS, verify it is scheduled and working, then commit and push all code
steps: Run 'bash infra/deploy-poller.sh' from the repo root /projects/sandbox/tpot-benchmark to create all AWS resources (SNS topic, IAM role, Lambda function, EventBridge rule).
Verify Lambda exists: aws lambda get-function --function-name tpot-bench-capacity-poller --region us-east-1
Verify EventBridge rule exists and is ENABLED: aws events describe-rule --name tpot-bench-poll-capacity --region us-east-1
Do a test invocation: aws lambda invoke --function-name tpot-bench-capacity-poller --region us-east-1 --payload '{}' /tmp/lambda-out.json && cat /tmp/lambda-out.json

Check Lambda logs for the test invocation to confirm it ran without errors (or only got InsufficientCapacity which is expected): aws logs tail /aws/lambda/tpot-bench-capacity-poller --region us-east-1 --since 5m
Git add infra/ directory, commit with message 'feat: Lambda + EventBridge capacity poller for B300/H200 spot', and push to origin harden-ec2-bench-runner
acceptance_criteria: Lambda function tpot-bench-capacity-poller exists in us-east-1
EventBridge rule tpot-bench-poll-capacity exists and is ENABLED with rate(3 minutes)
Test invocation completes without Lambda runtime errors (InsufficientCapacity from EC2 is expected and acceptable)
All code committed and pushed to harden-ec2-bench-runner branch
verification: aws lambda get-function --function-name tpot-bench-capacity-poller --region us-east-1 returns successfully
aws events describe-rule --name tpot-bench-poll-capacity --region us-east-1 shows State=ENABLED
aws lambda invoke succeeds (status 200) and output shows no unhandled exceptions
git status shows clean working tree after push
findings: Deployment successful. Lambda found H200 capacity in us-east-2a and launched 3 benchmark p5en.48xlarge instances (i-04210a40bf95d360c @ 18.224.58.212, i-0f7a557cef7944c75 @ 3.14.245.133, i-0e3e92b1459168f17 @ 3.128.206.200). EventBridge rule self-disabled after launch. Increased Lambda timeout from 60s to 120s to prevent timeouts during cross-region probing. B300 (p6-b300.48xlarge) had InsufficientInstanceCapacity across all regions (expected). Instances left running per user request for SSH access.
